title: Stabilize Crow release-review and recipient-visible publication inputs

origin.reduction: Synthetic minimal candidate with a real MANIFEST.txt, required fabrication/source/pre-review artifacts, exact review inputs and an isolated recipient-visible Git population. It preserves stale review subject, omitted publishable member and recursive archive failure classes. Four legitimate review outputs remain deferred. It does not replay the complete Crow release, a live reviewer, remote provider behavior, release sealing or publication.

history.disposition: retired metadata-only refresh because the review subject remained stale
history.reconsider_when: the current producer, candidate and live inputs reopen to one exact review subject

history.disposition: retired review reuse after candidate identity changed
history.reconsider_when: a fresh review is commissioned against the exact current packet

history.disposition: retired recursive evidence archive and oversized outgoing population
history.reconsider_when: recipient-visible Git membership and bounded transport census both pass
